title: Review: proration lines for mid-period plan changes
claimed_change:
Add subs/proration.py for mid-period plan changes.
- remaining_days(period, change_date): days from change_date (inclusive) to period.end (exclusive); ValueError if change_date is outside the period.
- plan_change_lines(old_plan, new_plan, period, change_date) returns [credit for the unused part of old_plan (negative), charge for the remaining part of new_plan], both kind 'proration'; [] when the plan code is unchanged; ValueError if the plans' currencies differ.
- Each amount is plan.monthly_price * remaining_days / period.days computed with exact Decimal arithmetic and rounded once, per line, following the house rule in money.py: half-up to cents (ties such as 1.665 -> 1.67).
- apply_plan_change(invoice, old_plan, new_plan, period, change_date) adds the lines to the invoice (ValueError on currency mismatch) and returns their net amount.
- Add tests.

ground_truth.description: _prorated sets ctx.rounding = ROUND_HALF_UP inside localcontext() but calls exact.quantize(CENT) after the with block has exited, so the quantize uses the default context rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). Exact half-cent prorations round to even instead of up: Starter 9.99 with 5 of 30 days gives -1.66 instead of -1.67. Fix: quantize inside the context or pass rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP / use money.round_money.
